title: MatLoom: Layered Text-to-Material Generation in a Compact Program Space
title_zh: MatLoom：在紧凑程序空间中的分层文本到材质生成

paragraphs.en: Material generation should produce not only an appearance, but also the rules that construct it. We introduce MatLoom , a compact, layer-oriented language for text-to-material generation with pretrained language models. Each program composes alpha-masked layers whose shared spatial expressions define coverage and physically based rendering (PBR) channels, making dependencies between patterns, color, and relief explicit. A standalone interpreter evaluates the program into material maps, while the source retains named fields and layer parameters for subsequent authoring. Without task-specific fine-tuning, our pipeline uses parser-guided repair and preview-based critique to revise material designs, then searches noise seeds while keeping each candidate’s remaining source fixed. On a curated benchmark of 141 141 prompts evaluated with six backbones, our best-performing configuration achieves higher mean scores than three diffusion baselines on all four flat-layout prompt-alignment metrics. Its initial programs already exceed all three baselines on mean BLIPScore, before critique or seed search. Retained programs have a median length of 21 21 lines when pooled across backbones. In a blind four-way comparison involving 30 30 participants and 20 20 prompts, our renders receive 59.2 % 59.2\% of choices, compared with 19.3 % 19.3\% for the most-preferred baseline. Compact executable programs thus offer a way to generate prompt-aligned materials while retaining their construction as part of the asset.
paragraphs.zh: 材料生成不仅应产生外观，还应生成构建该外观的规则。 我们提出了 MatLoom，一种紧凑的、以层为单位的文本到材料生成语言，可与预训练语言模型配合使用。 每个程序由带有 alpha 遮罩的层组成，这些层共享的空间表达式定义了覆盖范围和基于物理的渲染（PBR）通道，从而明确模式、颜色和浮雕之间的依赖关系。 一个独立的解释器将程序评估为材料贴图，而源代码则保留命名字段和层参数，以便后续创作使用。 无需针对特定任务进行微调，我们的流程利用解析器引导的修复和基于预览的批评来修改材料设计，然后在保持每个候选方案其余源代码不变的情况下搜索噪声种子。 在包含 141 个提示词的精选基准数据集上，使用六种基础模型进行评估，我们表现最佳的配置在所有四项平面布局提示词对齐指标上均获得了高于三种扩散基线模型的平均分数。 其初始程序在未进行批评或种子搜索之前，在平均 BLIPScore 上就已经超过了所有三种基线模型。 保留的程序在各基础模型中汇总后的平均长度为 21 行。 在一项涉及 30 名参与者和 20 个提示词的盲测四向比较中，我们的渲染结果获得了 59.2% 的选择，而最受欢迎的基线模型仅获得 19.3% 的选择。 因此，紧凑的可执行程序提供了一种生成与提示词对齐的材料的方法，同时将其构建过程作为资产的一部分保留下来。

paragraphs.en: Material authoring rarely ends with the first render. A designer may ask to widen the grout between tiles, roughen a coating, or change a glaze color while preserving the rest of the surface (Figure 5 ). Text-to-material diffusion methods generate detailed physically based rendering (PBR) maps ( Vecchio et al., 2024 ; Vecchio, 2026 ; Kocsis et al., 2025 ) , but their raster outputs do not expose the construction rules behind spatial layout, relief, and reflectance. Procedural programs and graphs keep those rules as operations and parameters ( Guerrero et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ) , making the generated asset easier to inspect, re-evaluate, and revise.
paragraphs.zh: 材料创作很少会因第一次渲染而结束。 设计师可能会要求加宽瓷砖之间的填缝、使涂层更粗糙，或更改釉面颜色，同时保留表面的其余部分（图 5）。 文本到材料的扩散方法能够生成基于物理的渲染（PBR）的详细贴图（Vecchio 等人，2024；Vecchio，2026；Kocsis 等人，2025），但其光栅化输出并未揭示空间布局、浮雕和反射率背后的构建规则。 过程化程序和图将这些规则以操作和参数的形式保留下来（Guerrero 等人，2022；Li 等人，2024；Li 等人，2025），使得生成的资产更容易被检查、重新评估和修改。

paragraphs.en: Can compact material programs serve as an effective output space for pretrained language models, combining text-to-material fidelity with explicit authoring structure? This question follows a broader line of work on programs as visual representations ( Sharma et al., 2018 ; Jones et al., 2020 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) . For materials, the representation must express coupled decisions: a tile lattice defines both coverage and height, a crack has shape and relief, and a coating changes reflectance only where it is applied. Existing material languages and systems expose different parts of this structure. MDL supports declarative material definitions and layering ( Kettner et al., 2015 ; NVIDIA, 2014 ) ; MultiMat serializes Substance graphs in a compact DSL with validation and visual feedback ( Belouadi et al., 2026 ) ; and Material Apprentice synthesizes procedural materials from text by retrieving expert process traces ( Gupta et al., 2026 ) . We study a more restricted point in this design space: a layer-oriented field language between a natural-language request and rendered material maps.
paragraphs.zh: 紧凑的材料程序能否成为预训练语言模型的有效输出空间，从而将文本到材料的保真度与明确的创作结构相结合？ 这个问题延续了更广泛的研究方向，即将程序视为视觉表现形式（Sharma 等人，2018；Jones 等人，2020；Zhang 等人，2025；Wu 等人，2025）。 对于材料而言，其表示必须能够表达相互耦合的决策：瓷砖晶格同时定义了覆盖范围和高度，裂缝具有形状和凹凸特征，而涂层仅在应用位置改变反射率。 现有的材料语言和系统揭示了这种结构的不同部分。 MDL 支持声明式材料定义和分层（Kettner 等人，2015；NVIDIA，2014）；MultiMat 将 Substance 图以紧凑的 DSL 序列化，并具备验证和视觉反馈功能（Belouadi 等人，2026）；而 Material Apprentice 则通过检索专家流程轨迹，从文本中合成程序化材料（Gupta 等人，2026）。 我们研究的是这一设计空间中一个更为受限的焦点：一种以分层为导向的领域语言，介于自然语言请求与渲染后的材料图之间。

paragraphs.en: We introduce MatLoom , a compact language that represents a material as a stack of alpha-masked layers (Figure 1 ). Each layer assigns PBR channels through expressions over a two-dimensional domain, and named spatial fields can be shared across masks, color, roughness, and height. This design exposes three authoring decisions to the model: which spatial patterns to define, how layers use those patterns, and which stochastic realization of the noise fields to render. A standalone interpreter evaluates the program into material maps at a chosen raster resolution, with pinned noise seeds for repeatable execution within a fixed implementation. The restricted vocabulary trades the breadth of a general graph or shader language for concise programs whose dependencies remain visible in source.
paragraphs.zh: 我们介绍了 MatLoom，一种紧凑型语言，它将材料表示为一系列经过阿尔法遮罩的层（图 1）。 每一层都通过二维域上的表达式分配 PBR 通道，并且命名后的空间场可以在多个遮罩、颜色、粗糙度和高度之间共享。 这种设计向模型暴露了三种创作决策：定义哪些空间模式、各层如何使用这些模式，以及渲染噪声场的哪种随机实现。 一个独立的解释器会在选定的光栅分辨率下将程序评估为材料贴图，并通过固定噪声种子确保在固定实现中可重复执行。 这种受限的词汇表以牺牲通用图或着色器语言的广泛性为代价，换取了结构简洁且依赖关系在源代码中清晰可见的程序。

paragraphs.en: Our synthesis procedure uses that separation to organize inference. A pretrained language model writes and repairs a program using parser feedback. A critic then inspects a fast preview, channel statistics, and source code where configured, and revises the material design. Finally, a text–image scorer selects candidates from the revision trajectory and searches noise seeds while keeping each candidate’s other expressions fixed. The same explicit program is therefore the object of generation, repair, critique, selection, seed exploration, and later rendering.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的合成流程利用这种分离来组织推理。 一个预训练的语言模型会根据解析器的反馈编写和修复程序。 随后，一个评论者会检查快速预览、通道统计信息以及（在配置时指定的）源代码，并对材料设计进行修订。 最后，一个文本-图像评分器会从修订轨迹中挑选候选项，并在保持每个候选项其他表达不变的情况下搜索噪声种子。 因此，同一个显式程序既是生成、修复、评论和选择的对象，也是种子探索和后续渲染的对象。

Across retained programs from all backbones, the median length is 21 21 lines. The best configuration exceeds the baselines in mean score on all four flat-layout alignment metrics, and its initial programs already exceed all baselines on mean BLIPScore before critique or seed search. paragraphs.en: A synthesis procedure that separates design from realization. Parser-guided repair and preview-based critique revise programs, while seed search explores stochastic variants of fixed candidate designs without task-specific fine-tuning (Section 4 ).

paragraphs.en: Inverse rendering estimates spatially varying reflectance from photographs ( Deschaintre et al., 2018 ; Deschaintre et al., 2019 ; Guo et al., 2020 ; Lopes et al., 2024 ) , and text-conditioned systems synthesize PBR maps from language or other visual inputs ( He et al., 2023 ; Vecchio et al., 2024 ; Vecchio, 2026 ; Kocsis et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2026 ) . These raster maps support rendering, relighting, and some map-level editing. MatLoom instead retains an executable source program, so the construction of the maps can be inspected, re-evaluated, and resampled. Our diffusion comparisons therefore test rendered appearance against strong raster baselines, not superiority over procedural generators.
paragraphs.zh: 逆渲染技术通过照片估算空间变化的反射率（Deschaintre 等人，2018；Deschaintre 等人，2019；Guo 等人，2020；Lopes 等人，2024），而文本条件系统则根据语言或其他视觉输入合成 PBR 贴图（He 等人，2023；Vecchio 等人，2024；Vecchio，2026；Kocsis 等人，2025；Luo 等人，2026）。 这些光栅贴图支持渲染、重新布光和某些贴图级别的编辑。 MatLoom 则保留了一个可执行的源程序，因此可以检查、重新评估和重新采样贴图的构建过程。 因此，我们的扩散模型比较测试的是渲染外观与强大光栅基线之间的差异，而非相对于过程化生成器的优越性。

paragraphs.en: MATch optimizes existing procedural graphs ( Shi et al., 2020 ) , MatFormer and conditional MatFormer generate graph structure and parameters ( Guerrero et al., 2022 ; Hu et al., 2023 ) , and ProcMatRL improves image-conditioned parameter prediction ( Li et al., 2024 ) . VLMaterial generates Blender Python programs from images with a fine-tuned vision-language model ( Li et al., 2025 ) . MultiMat introduces CompactSBS, a compact YAML representation of Substance graphs with visual feedback, validation, and repair, evaluated on image-conditioned and unconditional tasks ( Belouadi et al., 2026 ) . MatLayerNet plans layered aging materials with LLM agents and a curated mask library ( Cai et al., 2026 ) . Material Apprentice is closest in task definition because it supports text-to-procedural generation and editing by retrieving expert process traces and compiling them into Blender graphs ( Gupta et al., 2026 ) . MatLoom focuses on a different representation choice: a restricted field vocabulary with ordered alpha-composited layers, standalone execution, explicit layer parameters, and text-conditioned synthesis by pretrained language models. Direct matched-budget comparisons to Material Apprentice, Blender Python, MDL, and other procedural representations remain future work.
paragraphs.zh: MATch 优化了现有的过程化图（Shi 等人，2020），MatFormer 和条件 MatFormer 可生成图结构和参数（Guerrero 等人，2022；Hu 等人，2023），而 ProcMatRL 则改进了基于图像的条件参数预测（Li 等人，2024）。 VLMaterial 利用微调后的视觉-语言模型从图像生成 Blender Python 程序（Li 等人，2025）。 MultiMat 引入了 CompactSBS，这是一种对 Substance 图的紧凑型 YAML 表示形式，支持视觉反馈、验证和修复，并在基于图像的条件和无条件任务中进行了评估（Belouadi 等人，2026）。 MatLayerNet 通过 LLM 智能体和精心挑选的掩码库规划分层老化材料（Cai 等人，2026）。 Material Apprentice 在任务定义上最为接近，因为它支持从文本到过程化的生成与编辑，具体方法是通过检索专家流程痕迹并将其编译为 Blender 图来实现（Gupta 等人，2026）。 MatLoom 则专注于不同的表示选择：一种受限的字段词汇表，包含有序阿尔法合成的图层、独立执行能力、显式的图层参数，以及通过预训练语言模型实现的文本条件合成。 与 Material Apprentice、Blender Python、MDL 及其他过程化表示形式进行直接匹配预算的比较仍属未来工作。

paragraphs.en: Graphics-program inference ( Ellis et al., 2018 ) , ShapeAssembly ( Jones et al., 2020 ) , and Scene Language ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) connect learned generation to editable visual structure. LAPS and LILO show how language can guide reusable program abstractions ( Wong et al., 2021 ; Grand et al., 2024 ) , while grammar prompting provides structured constraints for DSL generation ( Wang et al., 2023 ) . Program repair ( Xia et al., 2023 ) , iterative critique ( Madaan et al., 2023 ; Gou et al., 2024 ) , and rendered feedback ( Wu et al., 2025 ) are established components. MDL separates declarative material definitions, including layering, from rendering algorithms ( Kettner et al., 2015 ) ; MaterialX supports portable material graphs ( Academy Software Foundation, 2026 ) ; and OpenPBR specifies a surface shading model ( Portsmouth et al., 2025 ) . MatLoom combines program repair, rendered critique, and execution feedback inside a deliberately smaller material vocabulary. The goal is to measure the costs and benefits of that vocabulary, rather than to claim invention of portable material languages. Table 3 summarizes the task and representation boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: Graphics-program inference (Ellis et al., 2018)、ShapeAssembly (Jones et al., 2020) 和 Scene Language (Zhang et al., 2025) 将学习到的生成过程与可编辑的视觉结构连接起来。 LAPS 和 LILO 展示了语言如何引导可重用的程序抽象（Wong et al., 2021；Grand et al., 2024），而语法提示则为 DSL 生成提供了结构化约束（Wang et al., 2023）。 程序修复（Xia et al., 2023）、迭代批判（Madaan et al., 2023；Gou et al., 2024）和渲染反馈（Wu et al., 2025）是成熟的组成部分。 MDL 将声明式材料定义（包括分层）与渲染算法分离（Kettner et al., 2015）；MaterialX 支持便携的材料图（Academy Software Foundation, 2026）；而 OpenPBR 则指定了表面着色模型（Portsmouth et al., 2025）。 MatLoom 将程序修复、渲染批判和执行反馈整合到一个刻意缩小的材料词汇表中。 其目标是衡量该词汇表的成本与收益，而非声称发明了便携的材料语言。 表 3 总结了任务与表示的边界。

paragraphs.en: The representation separates editable source from sampled material maps (Figure 2 ). A program defines spatial fields, assigns them to layer coverage and PBR channels, and evaluates them at a chosen resolution. Layers group coverage with surface properties, named fields expose cross-channel dependencies, and explicit seeds distinguish a design from one stochastic realization.
paragraphs.zh: 该表示方法将可编辑的源数据与采样后的材质贴图分离开来（图2）。 一个程序定义空间场，将其分配给图层覆盖和PBR通道，并在选定的分辨率下进行评估。 图层将覆盖层与表面属性组合在一起，命名的场揭示了跨通道的依赖关系，而显式的种子则使一个设计区别于一次随机实现。

paragraphs.en: Our evaluation asks two questions: whether the complete authoring system produces renders that match material descriptions, and whether its recorded programs expose useful post-generation control. We therefore separate prompt-alignment results from evidence about the representation itself. The benchmark, trajectory analysis, and blind study measure rendered appearance; a manual edit case illustrates program-level control for one material. All means average the three recorded runs for each prompt and then average over 141 141 prompts, unless stated otherwise.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的评估提出两个问题：完整的创作系统生成的渲染结果是否与材料描述相符，以及其记录的程序是否提供了生成后有用的控制手段。 因此，我们将提示对齐的结果与关于表示本身的证据分开处理。 基准测试、轨迹分析和盲测用于衡量渲染后的外观；一个手动编辑案例则展示了针对一种材料的程序级控制。 除非另有说明，所有方法均对每个提示的三个记录运行取平均值，再对 141 个提示取平均。

paragraphs.en: The benchmark contains 141 141 prompts from four public sources: category prompts from Hu et al. (2023) ( 30 30 ), MatSynth descriptions ( Vecchio & Deschaintre, 2024 ) ( 11 11 ), StableMaterials prompts ( Vecchio, 2026 ) ( 50 50 ), and text2fabric descriptions ( Deschaintre et al., 2023 ) ( 50 50 ). Sources with more than 50 50 descriptions are reduced by farthest-point sampling in sentence-embedding space, with the selected prompt list fixed across methods. This curated benchmark includes figurative and specific motifs, so its average characterizes this prompt distribution rather than material requests in general.
paragraphs.zh: 该基准包含来自四个公开来源的 141 个提示：Hu et al. (2023) 提供的类别提示（30 个）、MatSynth 描述（Vecchio & Deschaintre, 2024）（11 个）、StableMaterials 提示（Vecchio, 2026）（50 个），以及 text2fabric 描述（Deschaintre et al., 2023）（50 个）。对于描述数量超过 50 个的来源，我们通过在句子嵌入空间中执行最远点采样进行缩减，且所选提示列表在所有方法中保持一致。该经过精心筛选的基准包含了比喻性和具体的图案，因此其平均值反映的是此类提示的分布特征，而非材料请求的整体情况。

paragraphs.en: We compare against three released text-to-material-map systems: MatFuse ( Vecchio et al., 2024 ) , StableMaterials ( Vecchio, 2026 ) , and IntrinsiX ( Kocsis et al., 2025 ) . All systems produce 512 × 512 512{\times}512 maps rendered in the same Blender scenes and in both flat and staged layouts. The layouts are useful but not representation-isolated: MatLoom ’s height drives geometric displacement, StableMaterials’ height drives bump shading, MatFuse and IntrinsiX emit no height map, and only MatLoom exposes transmission. We therefore interpret the comparison as complete-system appearance under the recorded rendering routes (Appendix K ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们将系统与三种已发布的文本到材质图系统进行了对比：MatFuse（Vecchio 等人，2024）、StableMaterials（Vecchio，2026）和 IntrinsiX（Kocsis 等人，2025）。 所有系统都生成了 512×512 的 512{\times}512 材质图，这些材质图是在相同的 Blender 场景中以平面布局和舞台布局两种方式渲染的。 这些布局很有用，但并非在表现上相互独立：MatLoom 的高度会引发几何位移，StableMaterials 的高度会影响凹凸着色，MatFuse 和 IntrinsiX 不输出高度图，而只有 MatLoom 支持透射效果。 因此，我们将此次对比解释为在既定渲染流程下（附录 K）的完整系统外观表现。

sents.en: We compare against three released text-to-material-map systems: MatFuse ( Vecchio et al., 2024 ) , StableMaterials ( Vecchio, 2026 ) , and IntrinsiX ( Kocsis et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 我们将系统与三种已发布的文本到材质图系统进行了对比：MatFuse（Vecchio 等人，2024）、StableMaterials（Vecchio，2026）和 IntrinsiX（Kocsis 等人，2025）。

sents.en: All systems produce 512 × 512 512{\times}512 maps rendered in the same Blender scenes and in both flat and staged layouts.
sents.zh: 所有系统都生成了 512×512 的 512{\times}512 材质图，这些材质图是在相同的 Blender 场景中以平面布局和舞台布局两种方式渲染的。

sents.en: The layouts are useful but not representation-isolated: MatLoom ’s height drives geometric displacement, StableMaterials’ height drives bump shading, MatFuse and IntrinsiX emit no height map, and only MatLoom exposes transmission.
sents.zh: 这些布局很有用，但并非在表现上相互独立：MatLoom 的高度会引发几何位移，StableMaterials 的高度会影响凹凸着色，MatFuse 和 IntrinsiX 不输出高度图，而只有 MatLoom 支持透射效果。

sents.en: We therefore interpret the comparison as complete-system appearance under the recorded rendering routes (Appendix K ).
sents.zh: 因此，我们将此次对比解释为在既定渲染流程下（附录 K）的完整系统外观表现。

paragraphs.en: Prompt alignment is scored with BLIPScore ( Li et al., 2023 ) , CLIPScore ( Hessel et al., 2021 ) , VQAScore ( Lin et al., 2024 ) , and an MLLM judge ( claude-sonnet-5 , temperature zero), each scaled to [ 0,100 ] [0,100] with higher better. These are learned visual proxies, not measures of physical accuracy or edit utility. The six MatLoom backbones each use three recorded authoring runs per prompt with procedural-noise seeds 42 42 , 123 123 , and 2026 2026 . Each main run uses an initial generation, 5 critique–revision rounds, trajectory selection, and up to 1000 1000 noise-seed variants for the first, selected, and last programs; this search budget is not matched to the diffusion baselines. For paired inference we use per-prompt run means, two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank tests, and 10,000 10{,}000 -resample percentile bootstrap confidence intervals, with Holm correction over the 24 24 flagship-versus-baseline contrasts. Because the flagship was selected after comparing all six backbones, these tests remain exploratory.

paragraphs.en: Backbone choice and prompt source both matter. All six program-generating configurations exceed the strongest diffusion baseline on flat BLIPScore, but only the flagship exceeds StableMaterials on mean flat judge score; the other 5 range from 45.8 45.8 to 56.8 56.8 against 57.4 57.4 . Per-source means also qualify the aggregate result: the flagship’s flat judge score trails StableMaterials on the StableMaterials-source and category prompts, while its overall judge advantage comes from MatSynth and text2fabric (Appendix N ). Thus the benchmark supports competitive prompt alignment for the full program-authoring system, while leaving open whether this representation would outperform other executable material languages under matched generation and rendering conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 骨干模型的选择和提示来源都至关重要。 所有六种程序生成配置在平直 BLIPScore 上均超越了最强的扩散基线，但只有旗舰配置在平均平直评分上超过了 StableMaterials；其余五种配置在 45.8 至 56.8 之间，而 StableMaterials 的得分为 57.4。 各来源的平均值也验证了综合结果：在基于 StableMaterials 来源和类别提示的任务中，旗舰配置的平直评分低于 StableMaterials，而其整体评分优势则来自 MatSynth 和 text2fabric（附录 N）。 因此，该基准测试支持整个程序编写系统的提示对齐具有竞争力，但尚未明确这种表示方式在匹配生成和渲染条件下是否优于其他可执行材料语言。

paragraphs.en: The flagship’s stored trajectory gives a within-run readout of the authoring loop (Table 2 ). Round 0 0 already reaches 48.31 48.31 BLIPScore and 61.35 61.35 judge in the flat layout, above all three diffusion baselines on those means. Five critique–revision rounds add + 3.5 +3.5 BLIPScore and + 6.3 +6.3 judge, while trajectory selection adds + 2.3 +2.3 BLIPScore over the last revision. The final polished output reaches 56.06 56.06 BLIPScore, but its flat judge score is slightly below round 5 5 . The selector beats the last revision on flat BLIPScore in 178 178 of 423 423 runs ( 42 % 42\% ), loses in 137 137 , and ties in 108 108 ; it also reduces mean flat judge by about one point. The trajectory therefore improves some alignment proxies while revealing disagreement between the quick selection score and other judgments (Appendix E ).
paragraphs.zh: 旗舰模型存储的轨迹提供了单次运行中生成循环的内部读数（表2）。 第0轮在平面布局中已达到48.31 BLIPScore和61.35 judge得分，高于所有三种扩散基线模型在这些指标上的平均值。 五轮批判-修订使BLIPScore增加了+3.5，judge得分增加了+6.3，而轨迹选择则在最后一次修订的基础上又使BLIPScore增加了+2.3。 最终润色后的输出达到了56.06 BLIPScore，但其平面布局下的judge得分略低于第5轮。 在423次运行中，选择器有178次在平面BLIPScore上优于最后一次修订（42%），137次表现更差，108次打平；同时它还使平均平面judge得分降低了约1分。 因此，该轨迹在提升某些对齐代理指标的同时，也揭示了快速选择得分与其他判断之间的分歧（附录E）。

paragraphs.en: We treat the stored component comparisons as exploratory diagnostics rather than ablations. They use one gpt-5.6-luna run per prompt and a temperature mismatch between the full reference and variants, although they remain paired by prompt. paragraphs.zh: 我们将存储的组件比较视为探索性诊断，而非消融实验。 他们每次提示使用一次 gpt-5.6-luna 运行，并且完整参考模型与变体之间存在温度不匹配，尽管它们仍按提示进行配对。 最有用的信号是负向信号：这些记录促使对渲染反馈、源访问、提示辅助和批评者选择进行受控测试，但它们并未识别出孤立组件的影响（附录 G）。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 illustrates how an authored program can be edited after generation. Starting from the final program for a two-layer tile material, we manually increase the tile roughness offset from 0.04 0.04 to 0.75 0.75 , widen grout by changing the shared mortar parameter from 0.02 0.02 to 0.06 0.06 , and shift tile base-color offsets to a blue glaze. All other source bytes, including noise seeds and the sampling window, are preserved. At both 256 × 256 256{\times}256 and 1024 × 1024 1024{\times}1024 , repeated evaluation in the recorded environment produces byte-identical previews; roughness and color edits change only their intended composited channels, while the grout edit deliberately propagates through channels that share the named mask (Appendix B ). This demonstrates inspectable control for one material, not an editing success rate, an automated editor, or an advantage over alternative program representations.
paragraphs.zh: 图 5 说明了生成后的程序如何被编辑。 从双层瓷砖材料的最终程序出发，我们手动将瓷砖粗糙度偏移量从 0.04 0.04 增加到 0.75 0.75，通过修改共享砂浆参数将其从 0.02 0.02 调整为 0.06 0.06 来扩大填缝宽度，并将瓷砖基础颜色偏移量调整为蓝色釉面效果。 所有其他源字节，包括噪声种子和采样窗口，均被保留。 在 256 × 256 256{\times}256 和 1024 × 1024 1024{\times}1024 两种分辨率下，在记录的环境中重复评估都能生成字节完全相同的预览图；粗糙度和颜色编辑仅改变其预期的合成通道，而填缝编辑则会刻意传播到共享命名遮罩的通道中（附录 B）。 这展示了对单一材料的可检查控制，而非编辑成功率、自动化编辑器或相较于其他程序表示形式的优势。

paragraphs.en: We ran a blind online preference study over 20 prompts, five from each benchmark source, drawn from the 141 141 -prompt benchmark with a seeded diversity-gated selection (Appendix J ). Each trial showed four unlabeled 512 × 512 512{\times}512 flat-layout renders in a 2 × 2 2{\times}2 grid: MatLoom with the flagship backbone and the StableMaterials, IntrinsiX, and MatFuse outputs, all at procedural seed 123 123 . paragraphs.en: MatLoom won 59.2 % 59.2\% of the 600 600 forced choices ( 95 % 95\% CI [ 55.8 , 62.7 ] [55.8,62.7] by participant-cluster bootstrap), ahead of StableMaterials at 19.3 % 19.3\% , IntrinsiX at 15.3 % 15.3\% , and MatFuse at 6.2 % 6.2\% . Every participant chose MatLoom more often than any one baseline across the 20 20 trials, with 8 8 – 17 17 MatLoom choices per participant. Mean fidelity ratings were 4.98 4.98 for MatLoom , 3.60 3.60 for StableMaterials, 3.01 3.01 for IntrinsiX, and 2.27 2.27 for MatFuse. The mean within-trial rating advantage over StableMaterials was 1.37 1.37 points on the 1 1 – 7 7 scale ( 95 % 95\% participant-cluster bootstrap CI [ 1.15 , 1.61 ] [1.15,1.61] ). The rating advantage over StableMaterials is positive under Wilcoxon signed-rank tests both by prompt ( n = 20 n{=}20 , p = 4.4 × 10 − 4 p{=}4.4\times 10^{-4} , rank-biserial 0.83 0.83 ) and by participant mean ( n = 30 n{=}30 , p = 6.5 × 10 − 7 p{=}6.5\times 10^{-7} ). The preference held descriptively for participants with no image-creation experience ( 60.0 % 60.0\% MatLoom win rate) and those with some experience ( 58.8 % 58.8\% ). The study measures prompt-conditioned appearance preference on this subset, not editing utility or physical accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: MatLoom 在 600 个强制选择中赢得了 59.2%（通过参与者-簇自助法计算的 95% 置信区间为 [55.8, 62.7]），领先于获得 19.3% 的 StableMaterials、获得 15.3% 的 IntrinsiX 以及获得 6.2% 的 MatFuse。 在所有 20 次试验中，每位参与者选择 MatLoom 的频率都高于任何单一基线模型，每位参与者平均选择了 8–17 次 MatLoom。 MatLoom 的平均保真度评分为 4.98，StableMaterials 为 3.60，IntrinsiX 为 3.01，MatFuse 为 2.27。 与 StableMaterials 相比，单次试验内的平均评分优势为 1.37 分（在 1–7 分量表上，通过参与者-簇自助法计算的 95% 置信区间为 [1.15, 1.61]）。 通过 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验，与 StableMaterials 相比的评分优势在提示条件（n = 20，p = 4.4 × 10⁻⁴，秩双序列相关系数为 0.83）和参与者均值（n = 30，p = 6.5 × 10⁻⁷）下均为正值。 在描述性层面，无图像创作经验的参与者（MatLoom 获胜率为 60.0%）和有一定经验的参与者（58.8%）均表现出对 MatLoom 的偏好。 本研究测量的是该子集中受提示条件影响的外观偏好，而非编辑效用或物理准确性。

paragraphs.en: The fixed primitive and channel vocabulary constrains fine microstructure, specific figurative motifs, participating media, and arbitrary reflectance models. The benchmark measures prompt alignment, not physical material accuracy, edit success, appearance consistency across resolutions, or causal value of the representation. Holm correction covers the 24 24 flagship-versus-baseline contrasts, but it does not account for selecting the flagship from six backbones on this benchmark, so these tests remain exploratory. The authoring pipeline uses a substantial and unmatched seed-search budget, and the diffusion baselines do not receive an equalized search or channel-routing treatment. The staged layout combines generation with renderer differences, including displacement, bump, height availability, and transmission. Component comparisons are exploratory because variant runs use one run per prompt (Appendix G ); they guide follow-up experiments rather than proving component necessity. Directly testing the representation hypothesis requires controlled generation and editing comparisons against other executable material forms under matched backbones, budgets, and rendering channels.
paragraphs.zh: 固定的原始元素和通道词汇表限制了精细的微观结构、特定的具象图案、参与介质以及任意的反射率模型。 该基准衡量的是提示对齐程度，而非物理材料的准确性、编辑的成功性、不同分辨率下的外观一致性或表示的因果价值。 Holm 校正涵盖了 24 组旗舰模型与基线模型的对比，但它并未考虑在此基准上从六个主干模型中选择旗舰模型这一因素，因此这些测试仍具有探索性质。 创作流程使用了大量且未匹配的种子搜索预算，而扩散基线模型并未获得同等水平的搜索或通道路由处理。 分阶段布局将生成过程与渲染器的差异结合在了一起，包括位移、凹凸、高度可用性和透射效果。 组件对比具有探索性质，因为不同变体的运行每次提示仅使用一次运行（附录 G）；它们为后续实验提供指导，而非证明组件的必要性。 要直接验证表示假设，需要在匹配的主干模型、预算和渲染通道下，通过受控的生成与编辑对比，将其与其他可执行的材料形式进行比较。

paragraphs.en: MatLoom studies text-to-material generation as executable authoring: compact layered programs retain the construction of each rendered asset. On the 141 141 -prompt benchmark, its strongest configuration exceeds three diffusion baselines on all four flat-layout alignment proxies and receives 59.2 % 59.2\% of choices in a 30 30 -person blind study over 20 20 prompts. Stored trajectories show that revision and seed search improve different proxies in different ways. Matched generation and editing comparisons are still needed to isolate the value of this representation from backbone, budget, and renderer effects.
paragraphs.zh: MatLoom 将文本到材料的生成研究为可执行的创作方式：紧凑的分层程序保留了每个渲染资产的结构。 在 141 141 -提示基准测试中，其最强配置在所有四个平面布局对齐代理上超越了三种扩散基线模型，并在一个包含 30 30 名参与者的盲测中，针对 20 20 个提示获得了 59.2 % 59.2\% 的选择支持。 存储的轨迹表明，修订和种子搜索以不同方式提升了不同的代理指标。 仍需进行生成与编辑的匹配比较，以将这种表示方法的价值与基础模型、预算和渲染器的影响区分开来。

paragraphs.en: This work studies the generation of digital surface materials from text. The release is limited to source code and does not redistribute benchmark prompts, baseline models, or third-party data or model weights, which remain subject to their original licenses. An authoring system may reproduce protected surface designs or generate assets that appear plausible but have unverified physical properties, so rendered appearance should not be treated as a measured material specification. The preference study was voluntary and began with informed consent. Participants could optionally provide an email address for follow-up, so responses were confidential rather than anonymous. The reported analysis excluded the email field and used de-identified responses.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究探讨了从文本生成数字表面材料的方法。 此次发布仅限于源代码，不重新分发基准提示词、基线模型或第三方数据或模型权重，这些内容仍受其原始许可协议的约束。 创作系统可能会复制受保护的表面设计，或生成看似合理但物理属性未经验证的资产，因此渲染出的外观不应被视为经过测量的材料规格。 偏好研究是自愿进行的，并以知情同意为开端。 参与者可以选择提供一个电子邮件地址用于后续联系，因此回应是保密的而非匿名的。 报告的分析排除了电子邮件字段，并使用了去标识化的回应数据。

paragraphs.en: The representation and compositing rules are specified in Section 3 , with an example program and grammar summary in Appendices B and C . Cross-engine agreement is tested on a finite fixture set with explicit tolerances and exclusions (Appendix D ). The quantitative tables and paired comparisons are computed from the stored per-run scores and the exported study responses (Appendix M ).

paragraphs.en: Listing 2 summarizes canonical program syntax in EBNF, with keyword-argument and lexical productions condensed for space. paragraphs.en: Worley uses a 64-bit hash in Python and a 32-bit hash in TypeScript, so identical seeds do not imply identical fields for this primitive. The browser’s WebGPU preview is outside the cross-engine comparison, while CPU worker backends have separate within-TypeScript parity tests. Browser channel packing quantizes IOR over [ 1 , 3 ] [1,3] , whereas the Python engine supports IOR values above 3 3 in its floating-point export. The Python HDR fallback clips negative height values, which require EXR to preserve. These differences limit claims of interchangeable numerical output.
paragraphs.zh: Worley 在 Python 中使用 64 位哈希，在 TypeScript 中使用 32 位哈希，因此对于此原语而言，相同的种子并不意味着字段相同。 浏览器的 WebGPU 预览不在跨引擎比较范围内，而 CPU 工作线程后端则有独立的 TypeScript 内部一致性测试。 浏览器通道打包将 IOR 量化到 [1, 3] 区间，而 Python 引擎在其浮点导出中支持高于 3 的 IOR 值。 Python 的 HDR 回退机制会截断负高度值，而保留这些值需要 EXR 格式。 这些差异限制了对数值输出可互换性的主张。

paragraphs.en: Table 8 reports recorded wall-clock times for the complete authoring runs, with every stage running sequentially in one process per prompt. For the flagship, the median run takes 4.6 4.6 minutes: 40 40 seconds for the six generation calls, 42 42 seconds for the six critique calls (one per trajectory program, the last triggering no revision), 1.7 1.7 seconds for trajectory selection, and 181 181 seconds for seed search over 2 or 3 candidates, with the remainder spent on lazy scorer loading and program canonicalization. The initial proposal has a median latency of 11 11 seconds, and each revision or critique call takes 5 to 7 seconds. Each seed sweep renders 1001 1001 candidates at 256 × 256 256{\times}256 and scores them in a median of 70 70 seconds, about 70 70 milliseconds per candidate, covering a preview evaluation and one text–image scorer encode. Critique and trajectory-selection renders use 512 × 512 512{\times}512 previews, and channel statistics are computed on a 128 × 128 128{\times}128 grid. The seed search is roughly constant across backbones, so end-to-end differences reflect the language-model calls, whose combined medians reach 910 910 seconds for the slowest backbone. The recorded hardware and scorer-device specifications are unavailable, so these wall-clock figures should not be used as cross-system latency comparisons.
paragraphs.zh: 表8报告了完整创作运行所记录的实际运行时间，每个阶段都按顺序在一个进程中执行，每个提示对应一个进程。 对于旗舰模型，中位数运行时间为4.6分钟：6次生成调用耗时40秒，6次批评调用耗时42秒（每个轨迹程序一次，最后一次未触发任何修订），轨迹选择耗时1.7秒，在2或3个候选项上进行种子搜索耗时181秒，其余时间用于惰性评分器加载和程序规范化。 初始提案的中位数延迟为11秒，每次修订或批评调用的时间为5至7秒。 每次种子扫描都会以256 × 256分辨率渲染1001个候选项，并以中位数70秒的时间进行评分，即每个候选项约70毫秒，包括一次预览评估和一次文本-图像评分器编码。 批评和轨迹选择的渲染使用512 × 512的预览图，通道统计则在128 × 128的网格上计算。 种子搜索在不同骨干模型之间的差异大致恒定，因此端到端的差异反映了语言模型调用的影响，其中最慢骨干模型的调用总中位数达到910秒。 记录下来的硬件和评分器设备规格不可用，因此不应将这些实际运行时间用于跨系统的延迟比较。

paragraphs.en: Seed search preserves all non-seed source within each candidate, including explicit lattice parameters, but noise can still affect masks, color, and height enough to reduce visual fidelity. Accepting a candidate only when its quick score improves protects that score, not appearance or external evaluation metrics. The choice of seed-only search is therefore a restriction of the search space rather than a guarantee against degradation. Independent judgments of the stored before-and-after programs are unavailable, so this comparison does not establish which search space gives better perceived materials.
paragraphs.zh: 种子搜索会保留每个候选项中所有非种子的源内容，包括显式的晶格参数，但噪声仍可能以足以降低视觉保真度的程度影响遮罩、颜色和高度。 仅当候选项的快速得分有所提升时才接受它，这种做法能保护该得分，却无法保护外观或外部评估指标。 因此，选择仅使用种子的搜索方式实际上是对搜索空间的限制，而非对质量下降的防护保证。 由于无法对存储的“之前”和“之后”程序进行独立判断，这种比较无法确定哪个搜索空间能带来更优质的感知材料效果。

paragraphs.en: We ran a blind online preference study, delivered through Qualtrics in English and Chinese. Twenty prompts, five from each benchmark source, were drawn from the 141 141 -prompt benchmark with a seeded random selection subject to a Jaccard-similarity diversity guard, and the selection was frozen before recruitment. The stimuli reused the seed- 123 123 flat-layout evaluation outputs of the flagship and the three baselines: 80 512 × 512 512{\times}512 renders, each recorded in a trial manifest with its checksum. MatLoom occupied each display position in exactly five of the 20 items, the remaining methods filled the other positions at random, and the layout was fixed per prompt rather than redrawn per participant. The session opened with informed consent and a background block recording image-creation experience and self-reported normal color vision. Trial order was randomized per participant in two 10-trial blocks, with an instructed attention check between them. Each trial showed the four unlabeled renders in a 2 × 2 2{\times}2 grid and recorded which image best matched the prompt together with a 1 1 – 7 7 prompt-fidelity rating for every image. Participation was voluntary and began with an informed-consent screen. The questionnaire did not request names, but participants could optionally provide an email address for follow-up, so responses were confidential rather than anonymous. The reported analysis excluded the email field and used de-identified responses.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开展了一项盲测在线偏好研究，通过 Qualtrics 以英语和中文进行呈现。 从包含 141 个提示词的基准集中抽取了 20 个提示词，每个基准来源提供 5 个，采用预设种子的随机选择方法，并受 Jaccard 相似性多样性约束；在招募开始前即已锁定所选提示词。 刺激材料重用了旗舰模型与三种基线模型在种子为 123 时的扁平布局评估输出：均为 80×512×512 的渲染图像，每张图像均记录于试验清单中并附带其校验和。 MatLoom 在 20 个项目中恰好占据每个显示位置的 5 次，其余方法随机填充其他位置；布局按提示词固定，而非为每位参与者重新绘制。 试验开始前，系统会显示知情同意书，并记录参与者的图像创作经验及自我报告的正常色觉情况。 每位参与者的试验顺序在两个各含 10 个试验的区块中随机化，两区块之间设有明确的注意力检查环节。 每次试验展示四个未标注的渲染图像，以 2×2 网格排列，并记录参与者认为最匹配提示词的图像，以及对每张图像的 1–7 分提示词忠实度评分。 参与完全自愿，并以知情同意界面作为开端。 问卷未要求提供姓名，但参与者可选择提供电子邮件地址以便后续联系，因此回答是保密的而非匿名的。 报告中的分析排除了电子邮件字段，并使用了去标识化的回答数据。

paragraphs.en: The frozen analysis treated the pooled forced-choice share and the mean rating per method as primary outcomes, with uncertainty estimated by a participant-cluster bootstrap ( 10,000 10{,}000 resamples), and tested the MatLoom -versus-StableMaterials rating difference by Wilcoxon signed-rank tests at both the prompt and participant levels. Thirty participants completed the study, all passed the attention check, and none was excluded, leaving 600 600 paired decisions with no straight-line response patterns. Table 11 reports the outcomes. MatLoom won 59.2 % 59.2\% of forced choices with a mean rating of 4.98 4.98 , StableMaterials followed at 19.3 % 19.3\% and 3.60 3.60 , IntrinsiX at 15.3 % 15.3\% and 3.01 3.01 , and MatFuse at 6.2 % 6.2\% and 2.27 2.27 . The rating advantage over StableMaterials was positive at both test levels ( p = 4.4 × 10 − 4 p{=}4.4\times 10^{-4} prompt-level, p = 6.5 × 10 − 7 p{=}6.5\times 10^{-7} participant-mean), and MatLoom was the forced choice on every one of the 20 prompts by at least 4 of the 30 participants. Ten participants ( 33 % 33\% ) reported no image-creation experience and 20 ( 67 % 67\% ) reported some, and MatLoom ’s win rate was 60.0 % 60.0\% in the inexperienced group against StableMaterials’ 21.5 % 21.5\% , and 58.8 % 58.8\% in the experienced group against 18.2 % 18.2\% . Median per-trial completion time was 36.5 36.5 seconds, and participants gave free-text reasons on 192 192 of the 600 600 trials.

paragraphs.en: This is a consequence of evaluating unchanged dependencies, not a guarantee that an edit produces a perceptually local image change. A roughness edit may alter reflected highlights across the rendered surface even when the color and height maps are unchanged. Conversely, a coverage edit generally enters several composited channels, and a height edit also propagates to derived normals and approximate ambient occlusion.
paragraphs.zh: 这是评估未发生变化的依赖关系所导致的结果，而非保证编辑操作只会产生感知上的局部图像变化。 即使颜色和高度图没有变化，粗糙度编辑仍可能改变渲染表面上反射的高光区域。 相反，覆盖度编辑通常会影响到多个合成通道，而高度编辑也会传播到派生法线以及近似环境遮蔽中。

paragraphs.en: Each layer carries coverage α ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \alpha\in[0,1] , sRGB base color in [ 0,255 ] [0,255] , surface-response channels including roughness and metallicity, emission, and height h h in coordinate units. Each scalar component may be an expression over position. For finite values, the engine clamps coverage and weights to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , color to its stated range, index of refraction to at least 1 1 , and emissive strength to nonnegative values. Height is not clamped, and omitted channels take documented defaults. The surface channels correspond to a subset of OpenPBR inputs ( Portsmouth et al., 2025 ) and are mapped to renderer parameters such as the Principled BSDF ( Burley, 2012 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 每一层都包含覆盖度 α ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \alpha\in[0,1]、sRGB 基础颜色（范围 [ 0,255 ] [0,255]）、表面响应通道（包括粗糙度和金属度）、发射强度，以及以坐标单位为度量的高度 h。 每个标量分量都可以是位置相关的表达式。 对于有限值，引擎会将覆盖度和权重限制在 [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] 范围内，颜色限制在其指定范围，折射率至少限制为 1，发射强度则限制为非负值。 高度不会被限制，而省略的通道将采用文档中定义的默认值。 表面通道对应于 OpenPBR 输入的一部分（Portsmouth 等人，2025），并被映射到渲染器的参数，例如 Principled BSDF（Burley，2012）。

paragraphs.en: Listing 1 makes source dependencies inspectable. Its bottom layer describes grout, while the upper layer uses tileMask as coverage and as a factor in its height expression. Changing the mortar parameter of this shared mask changes both the exposed grout region and the tile relief boundary. The explicit multiplication by tileMask tapers height at the edge, so the taper comes from the source program rather than the compositing rule.

paragraphs.en: The upper layer’s glazeGrain field appears only in its roughness expression, whereas glazeRipple appears in both base color and height. With the remaining canonical source and sampling settings fixed, an edit confined to glazeGrain preserves the color and height maps, while an edit to glazeRipple can change both. These are checkable properties of this program’s dependencies, and do not imply that an automatically generated program will choose an equally useful decomposition.
paragraphs.zh: 上层的光泽颗粒（glazeGrain）字段仅出现在其粗糙度表达式中，而光泽波纹（glazeRipple）则同时出现在基础颜色和高度中。 在其余标准源和采样设置保持不变的情况下，仅对光泽颗粒（glazeGrain）的修改会保留颜色和高度贴图，而对光泽波纹（glazeRipple）的修改则可能同时改变两者。 这些是该程序依赖项的可验证属性，并不意味着自动生成的程序会选择同样有用的分解方式。

paragraphs.en: An inlined serialization removes named definitions by replacing every use with a copy of its resolved expression while keeping explicit noise seeds verbatim. Of the 2538 2538 stored initial programs, 2514 2514 ( 99 % 99\% ) use named definitions, inlining raises source length by a median factor of 1.4 1.4 , and the inlined form re-parses and exports channel maps byte-identical to the named-field form for every one of these programs. This equivalence lets future generation and editing comparisons vary explicit reuse and serialization length while holding evaluation semantics fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 内联序列化通过用其解析后的表达式的副本替换每个使用处来移除命名定义，同时逐字保留显式噪声种子。 在存储的 2538 个初始程序中，有 2514 个（99%）使用了命名定义；内联操作使源代码长度中位数增加了 1.4 倍，并且对于所有这些程序，其内联形式都会重新解析并导出与命名字段形式字节完全相同的通道映射。 这种等价性使得未来的生成和编辑比较可以在保持评估语义不变的同时，改变显式重用和内联序列化的长度。

paragraphs.en: An explicit-channel form without layer grouping has no established equivalent yet. Expanding the layer stack faithfully must preserve the zero-coverage branch, color-space conversion, and separate maximum-height rule, and a generic weighted sum would change the target semantics. Direct Blender, native graph, or other material-generation systems provide complementary end-to-end comparisons, but changing their library and execution interface does not isolate the effect of named fields or layers.
paragraphs.zh: 一种没有层分组的显式通道形式目前还没有公认的对应形式。 要忠实地扩展层堆栈，必须保留零覆盖分支、颜色空间转换以及独立的最大高度规则，而通用的加权求和会改变目标语义。 直接使用 Blender、原生图或其他的材质生成系统可以提供互补的端到端对比，但更改它们的库和执行接口并不能孤立出命名字段或层的影响。

paragraphs.en: The seed-variant mechanism replaces repeated occurrences of the same numeric seed together, preserving equality groups and all non-seed source within each candidate structure. This is a source-level constraint. Attribute preservation and perceptual diversity still require measurement, especially when a seeded field drives coverage or relief.

paragraphs.en: Parser checks cover syntax, named references, and constructors, while a finite regression suite checks serialization against the canonical EBNF (Appendix C ). Neither establishes finite fields or successful rendering for every accepted program. For example, a well-formed square-root expression can be undefined at some positions. Generator instructions also distinguish color visibility from maximum height and explain that constant height creates no slope, while linear height produces a tilted normal. Finite cross-engine tests have explicit tolerances, differing Worley hashes, and excluded GPU shading (Appendix D ). They do not establish identical images across renderers.
paragraphs.zh: 解析器检查语法、命名引用和构造函数，而有限回归测试套件则根据标准的 EBNF（附录 C）验证序列化过程。 这两者均未确立有限域或对每个被接受的程序都能成功渲染。 例如，一个格式正确的平方根表达式在某些位置上可能没有定义。 生成器指令还区分了颜色可见性与最大高度，并说明恒定高度不会产生坡度，而线性高度则会生成倾斜的法线。 跨引擎的有限测试具有明确的容差、不同的沃利哈希值，并且排除了 GPU 着色（附录 D）。 它们并未确保不同渲染器之间生成完全相同的图像。

paragraphs.en: The quick render evaluates the composited maps and height-derived normals, then shades a head-on swatch under a fixed directional light. It uses approximate Blinn-Phong specular shading, Fresnel, sheen, subsurface, and transmission terms rather than path tracing. It does not reproduce global illumination or physical refraction, so feedback can miss effects that become visible in a staged render. The material statistics contain 28 28 descriptors of the unlit channel maps, covering albedo, texture, roughness, metallicity, height, normal tilt, occlusion, and other channel summaries. Each statistic is paired with a short definition.
paragraphs.zh: 快速渲染器会评估合成后的贴图和高程导出的法线，然后在固定方向光下对正面样本进行着色。 它使用近似的 Blinn-Phong 镜面着色、菲涅尔效应、光泽度、次表面散射和透射项，而非路径追踪。 它无法再现全局光照或物理折射，因此反馈可能会遗漏在分阶段渲染中才会显现的效果。 材质统计信息包含 28 个未受光通道贴图的描述符，涵盖反照率、纹理、粗糙度、金属度、高度、法线倾斜、遮挡及其他通道摘要。 每个统计项都配有一个简短的定义。

paragraphs.en: The representation targets surface appearance through spatial patterns, layers, and material channels. We retain prompts with figurative or highly specific motifs to test where this representation becomes restrictive. Every prompt is evaluated with both rendering layouts, and every scored run is retained in the quantitative tables. The text-only backbones, DeepSeek and GLM, receive code and statistics without the quick render during critique. The retained run tree contains 423 423 complete conversations per backbone and no aborted attempts; per-turn repair counts are not logged, so first-pass validity within a turn is not measured. The flagship’s recorded median authoring time is 4.6 4.6 minutes, with a median 68 % 68\% of time spent in polishing, the Stage III seed search (Appendix F ). Compact output size therefore should not be read as cheap authoring.
paragraphs.zh: 该表示方法通过空间模式、层和材料通道来捕捉表面外观。 我们保留了包含比喻或高度具体主题提示的样本，以测试这种表示方法在何种情况下会变得具有限制性。 每个提示都使用两种渲染布局进行评估，且所有获得分数的运行结果都被保留在定量表格中。 纯文本基础模型 DeepSeek 和 GLM 在评估时接收代码和统计数据，但没有进行快速渲染。 保留的运行树包含每个基础模型 423 次完整的对话，没有中断的尝试；每轮修复的次数未被记录，因此未测量单轮内的首次有效性。 旗舰模型记录的作者创作时间中位数为 4.6 分钟，其中 68% 的时间用于润色，即第三阶段种子搜索（附录 F）。 因此，不应将紧凑的输出尺寸理解为廉价的创作过程。

paragraphs.en: An exploratory parameter-search variant (Appendix I ) provides a qualitative diagnostic for proxy mismatch. Three separate runs for “a red brick wall” produce regular brick rows, a wall with broad breaks and irregular cracks, and a wavy texture without recognizable brick rows. The authors’ visual ordering differs from the recorded quick-score gains of + 2.0 +2.0 , + 3.7 +3.7 , and + 0.7 +0.7 points, with the largest quick-score increase assigned to the middle example. This motivates inspecting structural changes alongside proxy scores, but it does not establish a general failure rate for parameter search or guarantee that seed-only search preserves appearance.
paragraphs.zh: 一种探索性参数搜索变体（附录 I）为代理变量不匹配问题提供了定性诊断方法。 对“一面红砖墙”进行的三次独立运行，分别生成了规则的砖块排列、带有宽裂缝和不规则裂纹的墙壁，以及没有可识别砖块排列的波浪状纹理。 作者给出的视觉排序与记录下来的快速得分增益（+2.0 +2.0、+3.7 +3.7 和 +0.7 +0.7 分）存在差异，其中中间示例的得分增长最大。 这促使我们结合代理变量得分一同考察结构变化，但并未确立参数搜索的一般性失败率，也未保证仅使用种子值进行搜索能保留外观特征。

sents.zh: 作者给出的视觉排序与记录下来的快速得分增益（+2.0 +2.0、+3.7 +3.7 和 +0.7 +0.7 分）存在差异，其中中间示例的得分增长最大。

sents.en: This motivates inspecting structural changes alongside proxy scores, but it does not establish a general failure rate for parameter search or guarantee that seed-only search preserves appearance.
sents.zh: 这促使我们结合代理变量得分一同考察结构变化，但并未确立参数搜索的一般性失败率，也未保证仅使用种子值进行搜索能保留外观特征。
